layers.authority: Instituto das Florestas e Conservação da Natureza (IFCN), Governo Regional da Madeira
layers.process: Since 1 January 2026, non-residents over 12 pay to walk Madeira's classified walking trails, booked and paid in advance on the SIMplifica portal (or at authorised sales points, or through a tour operator with an IFCN agreement); show the digital ticket on the trail when asked. Per person: EUR 4.50 for one trail (about A$7.15), EUR 10.50 for PR1 Vereda do Areeiro, Pico do Arieiro to Pico Ruivo (A$16.69), EUR 9.00 for a day pass covering two or more trails (A$14.30), EUR 22.50 for 3 days (A$35.75) and EUR 52.50 for 7 days (A$83.43); passes don't include PR1. Bookings through an operator with an agreement cost less. Children 12 and under, and people with a disability of 60% or more, are exempt but still register, because daily numbers on each trail are capped. Not paying is an administrative offence. AUD at the RBA rate of 30 October 2026, A$1 = EUR 0.6293.

layers.authority: Instituto das Florestas e Conservação da Natureza (IFCN), Governo Regional da Madeira
layers.process: Scuba diving at the wreck dive sites and in the Garajau, Desertas and Selvagens nature reserves costs non-residents over 12 EUR 7.50 per person per day (about A$11.92), and camping in a designated camping area costs EUR 5 per tent per night (A$7.95); both are paid through SIMplifica. AUD at the RBA rate of 30 October 2026, A$1 = EUR 0.6293.

layers.authority: Visit Madeira (official Madeira tourism site) for the Madeira Natural Park trail PR8
layers.process: The Vereda da Ponta de São Lourenço (PR 8) charges visitors over 12 years old EUR 4.50 (about A$7.15 at the RBA rate of 30 October 2026, A$1 = EUR 0.6293); children 12 or under are exempt. Payment is through the SIMplifica portal (simplifica.madeira.gov.pt). The trail is listed as restricted, with temporary signed detours. The amount comes from a tourism page, not from the regional gazette or the park agency (IFCN), so confirm it with IFCN.

laws.rule: Funchal charges a municipal tourist tax of EUR 2 per guest per night (about A$3.18, RBA rate of 30 October 2026) for up to 7 consecutive nights, for non-residents of Madeira aged over 12. A proposed rise to EUR 4 from 1 January 2027 was under public consultation in October 2026.
laws.heading: Município do Funchal, Regulamento 764/2024

laws.rule: Madeira's classified walking trails managed by the Institute of Forests and Nature Conservation (IFCN) need a booked entry time slot on the SIMplifica portal, for everyone including those exempt from the fee. In 2026 visitors pay EUR 4.50 (about A$7.15) per trail, EUR 10.50 (about A$16.69) for the full PR1 Pico do Areeiro to Pico Ruivo, with 1, 3 and 7-day combined rates. Children 12 and under and residents don't pay. Fees are refunded only if the authorities close the trail.
